subject: Decision needed — short burst pack vs. prorated runway extension (NextBridge POC)
messages:
From: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@nextbridge.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nextbridge.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — short capacity bump for POC this week

Hi Jonas,

Running into a spike in model usage as we stress-test the integration. We have about 36 hours of heavy load left in the POC window and are concerned the current timeboxed allocation will burn out before we can validate peak latency. Two asks:

- Can Redwood provide a one-off burst pack (24/48 hour) we can buy now to finish the tests?
- Alternatively, are you open to a prorated 7-day extension at a reduced rate instead of the burst? Procurement would prefer an extension if pricing is clean.

Attaching a usage snapshot (nextbridge_usage_snapshot.csv) and the procurement team's standard terms (procurement_terms.pdf).

We need an answer by EOD tomorrow to avoid pausing tests. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Claire
Product Lead, NextBridge AI

--
Attachment: nextbridge_usage_snapshot.csv (csv, 48KB)
Attachment: procurement_terms.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
To: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@nextbridge.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nextbridge.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short capacity bump for POC this week

Hi Claire — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. Two quick options we can offer immediately:

1) One-off burst pack: 48 hours of guaranteed extra concurrency with priority routing. Price: $4,800 flat. No term change; applies only to the current POC run.

2) Pro-rated extension: add 7 calendar days to the POC window and reduce rate on the added days by 30% (applies only to tokens consumed during the extension). Estimated pro-rated cost based on your current burn: ~$3,100.

Operational differences: the burst pack keeps your timebox and SLA intact but is higher cost per effective token; the extension gives more runway for lower cost but means performance tests may be distributed across a longer window which could affect artifacts depending on your test deadlines.

If Procurement prefers the extension we can provision it and generate an amendment. If you want the burst, we can push capacity in <1 hour.

Tagging Kimberly and Marissa for pricing approval and quick legal/finance check.

--
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-10-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Quick ask — short capacity bump for POC this week

Kimberly / Marissa — quick internal: NextBridge is asking for either a 48h burst ($4.8k) or a 7-day pro-rated extension (~$3.1k). They prefer the extension from procurement, but Claire called out timing pressure — needs decision by EOD tomorrow.

Considerations:
- If we approve extension at 30% discount on the added days, we likely keep the deal on a smooth path and reduce friction with procurement.
- The burst pack is simpler operationally and gives them a hard SLO for that period, and we could bill it as a one-off service add-on (non-recurring).
- Should we require a short conversion clause that if they convert to Dedicated within 60 days we credit 50% of the burst cost toward the commitment? That might sweeten the bump and improve conversion economics.

My recommendation: approve the 7-day extension at 30% off, but add the conversion credit option (50% credit of prorated extension cost toward first month of Dedicated). Keeps price attractive and shows flexibility. If Procurement pushes back on amendment lead time, offer the 48h burst as contingency with a 25% credit if they convert to Dedicated within 30 days.

Ask: Kimberley, can you sign off on the 30% extension discount + conversion credit? Marissa, can you flag legal to prepare the amendment (short form) and confirm billing flow?

Thanks,
Jonas
From: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
To: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@nextbridge.ai>, jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-10-22T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short capacity bump for POC this week

Hi Claire — thanks for the details and the attachments. We can do the prorated 7-day extension at 30% off for the added days. To make this low friction for Procurement we will: 

- Issue a one-page amendment (no change to baseline term date other than adding the 7 calendar days) — Marissa, please share short form with Claire after I send.
- Add a conversion credit: 50% of the prorated extension charge will be credited toward the first month of a Dedicated commitment if NextBridge signs within 60 days.
- If you need immediate capacity and Procurement cannot sign the amendment quickly, we will provision the 48h burst pack as a contingency. That burst will be billed at $4,800 and, if you convert to Dedicated within 30 days, we will apply a 25% credit of that amount toward the Dedicated commitment.

Claire — please confirm you want the extension path and I'll route the amendment to Marissa to send over for Procurement's review. If you prefer the burst we can turn it on today after Procurement acknowledges.

Appreciate the heads up — happy to keep this lightweight.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

--
